profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA, trading under the ticker META. Its developer site presents AI models and tools for developers, including access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The site says Muse Spark is tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and that it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. It also describes a quick start that gets a first working request in under five minutes by pointing an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, and a search grounding tool that gives a model live access to the web.

The company's tracked AI product is Llama (Meta), an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted. Meta's most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reporting 200966000000 USD.

Meta faces several lawsuits in the record: State of New Mexico ex rel. Torrez v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the First Judicial District Court, Santa Fe County, New Mexico; Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. California is listed with a law exposure count of 281. A number of third-party MCP servers reference Meta advertising and related tools, including ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp, and com.adbloop/meta-ads.
